page.layout: One printed page, a title page in the middle of the book. Centred title block: the large italic "IN", then "S. JACOBI", "APOSTOLI", "EPISTOLAM", "CATHOLICAM", "COMMENTARIUS.". Faint text in both columns and across the head is show-through from the reverse side and is left out.
page.notes: The large "IN" is set as a decorative italic capital with a swash N. The faint two-column text, and the mirrored running head at the top ("EXPLICATIO EPIST. AD HEBR. C. XIII"), are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. The page number at top right is faint and uncertain.
